messages:
Alex Chen: Hey team — consolidated Broadview Health onboarding feedback. TL;DR: three near-term blockers that are driving renewal risk: SSO provisioning delays, per-route billing confusion, and embeddings drift causing poor search relevance. Sharing raw asks + suggested priority matrix below.

Maya Patel: thanks — can you paste the raw notes? I want to make sure we capture exact language for the product board.

Alex Chen: sure. raw notes from calls (condensed):
- SSO: Okta provisioning took 6 business days; they need SCIM + better doc for user role mappings.
- Billing: finance confused about per-route vs per-token pricing, asked for a per-feature toggle on invoices.
- Embeddings: search results degrading after daily retrain; similarity thresholds feel inconsistent.
- Onboarding UX: KB article missing step to seed initial examples.

Sam Ortega: quick clarifying q: the billing ask — are they asking for a UI toggle per project to enable per-route billing, or just clearer invoice labels?

Alex Chen: both. they want temporary per-route toggle during onboarding (so they can turn it off later) + clearer invoice line items.

Jamie Liu: put me down for SSO follow-up. I can own the Okta/SCIM doc + a small runbook. ETA: Tues EOD?

Maya Patel: I can draft the invoice language and get finance to confirm phrasing. Sam, can you scope the UI effort for a per-project toggle?

Sam Ortega: will look into effort. quick estimate: 3 dev days for backend + 1 frontend day if we reuse existing feature flags. I'll confirm by EOD.

Alex Chen: adding a tiny prioritization matrix I sketched during the call: (Impact / Effort)
- SSO / SCIM: High impact / Medium effort -> P0 for this account (renewal risk)
- Billing UI clarity + toggle: Medium impact / Low effort -> P0-P1 (quick win)
- Embeddings drift (eval + thresholds): High impact / High effort -> P1 (need research)
- KB seed steps: Low impact / Low effort -> P2 (docs task)

CSBot: New ticket created: CS-5482 (Broadview onboarding: SSO + billing + embeddings notes) by Alex Chen

Maya Patel: can someone capture sample language for the invoice? I'll send to finance after. Example: `Line item: "Per-route usage (dev/onboard): $X" — with a note linking to config UI.`

Sam Ortega: re embeddings — do we have the exact drift examples? need 1-2 failing queries + expected vector similarity numbers. Alex, can the Broadview engineer share top 3 queries?

Alex Chen: yes, I'll request logs and ask for screenshots. also asked for GA event for search_quality so we can track moving forward.

Jamie Liu: for SCIM runbook I'll include: Okta app config snippet, mapping table for roles, troubleshooting checklist. anyone want to review before I post?

Maya Patel: happy to review. also recommend we ship the invoice wording + a short onboarding checklist this week to reduce churn.

Alex Chen: proposed owners: Jamie -> SSO doc + runbook; Sam -> billing toggle scoping; Maya -> invoice language + finance sync; Alex -> collect embeddings examples & create eval ticket. I'll update CS-5482 with owners + due dates.

Sam Ortega: FYI: if toggle is small, we can ship as a feature flag to their tenant by next week.

Maya Patel: can we capture a prioritized request for Product (for roadmap intake)? suggest marking SSO + billing UI as account-P0 and embeddings evaluation as research-P1.

Alex Chen: agreed. I'll add a summary for Product and request a canary rollout option in Dedicated for the toggle.

Jamie Liu: tagging @Product in the doc when ready will help.

Alex Chen: done for now — I’ll post updates in the ticket. Will share Broadview screenshots when I get them. :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: awesome, thanks all. :pray:

Sam Ortega: thanks — ping if you need quick scoping help.

CSBot: Ticket CS-5482 updated: assignees set -> Jamie Liu, Sam Ortega, Maya Patel, Alex Chen

Alex Chen: closing the loop here — next steps in ticket. If we want a short customer-facing summary for their CSM, I can draft a 1-paragraph note.

Maya Patel: please do, that'll help tone down renewal risk.

Alex Chen: will send draft by tomorrow morning.
